string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Movies and Series: the details page shows the movie or series scene sent by the list behind it, darkened so the text stays easy to read
Hold BACK, in any app or on the home screen, to open the quick panel (the short press still goes back as before)
Hold HOME to open Home: the lights and scenes from Home Assistant
Each home screen icon has its own color and a short animation of its own: the TV turns on, the film runs, the radio sends out waves, the headphones play an equalizer
The top bar folds away again while you browse (the glass bar is still an option in Settings)
When you leave an app, the home screen goes back to the item that opened it, not to TV

Every item on the home screen now shows its useful details, one per line: episode and time left, year, rating and length of a movie, what you last watched in each app and when, the last radio station, controllers and the Discord crew
A long piece of information, like the title of the last video, now ends in “…” and no longer pushes the others out; “Opened 0 minutes ago” became “Opened now”
Home: with Home Assistant offline, the screen says what happened and that it retries by itself, and Google Home stays at hand
After the screensaver, focus returns to the home screen, not to the top bar
Lighter navigation: the selected icon only starts its animation after the column stops moving
